name: way-servidores
description: Painel de gerenciamento de servidores Minecraft multi-versão e multi-motor (Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w workers && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
